title: Left All-Moving Stabilator
summary: All-moving left horizontal tail surface mounted on the left tail boom, operating symmetrically for pitch and differentially for roll.
role: Provides primary pitch authority (coupled with 2D thrust vectoring) and high-speed differential roll control.
materials: Composite skins with titanium pivot spindle.

modelingNotes.proportionReference: Public top 3-view planform (~8.8 m total stabilator span)
